verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs say webhooks can receive and process incoming emails, and separately claim real-time notifications about email events. Together these indicate first-party outbound event callbacks, but the evidence is thin: one-line claims with no detail on how a subscription is set up. Missing for 10: documented registration/configuration of webhook endpoints, a list of subscribable event types beyond email/inbound email, payload and security details (signing, retries), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Receive and process incoming emails through webhooks to handle customer inquiries and support requests.
Receive real-time notifications about email events and automate workflows.
